profile.headline: SRE @ Gridiron IT
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: DevOps Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing scalable software and modernizing enterprise platforms across the private sector and the U.S. Department of Defense. Recent work includes leading legacy application modernization, developing FastAPI-based services, migrating applications to Kubernetes, and building CI/CD pipelines to automate container validation and deployment. Experienced in Python, Kubernetes, Docker, cloud-native architectures, and software automation, with a strong foundation in delivering secure, maintainable, and high-performance engineering solutions.

positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Software Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Kubernetes · DevOps · Helm (Software) · REST APIs

positions.description: Provided technical support for senior leadership along with collaborating with other organizations to facilitate engagement and support for sustainable technology solutions.
